newsitem.title: USA: MVSI will trade 300,000 shrs for Expert.
newsitem.headline: MVSI will trade 300,000 shrs for Expert.

text.p: MVSI Inc said Thursday it will exchange 300,000 shares of its common stock with all the shares held by the sole owner of Expert Inc in its previously announced deal to acquire the privately-owned company.
MVSI did not disclose the name of Expert's sole owner.
MVSI said it will exchange less than three percent of its outstanding shares.
The company said the are restricted and cannot be sold for at least one year from the day it was issued.
The company said it will release more details when the deal closes by June 16.
MVSI is a Washington, D.C. technology products and services company.
